cross-cutting-functionalities.title: Unobservability
cross-cutting-functionalities.content: Unobservability means that neither wallet providers nor issuers shall be able to track where a holder uses his/her credentials or learns details concerning the attributes provided.

requirements.title: Unobservability Requirement 1
requirements.content: The issuer should not be able to learn details (to whom the presentation was made when the presentation was made, etc.) of the presentation
